title: Where the optimum can be
heading: The Optimum Always Lies Between the Incumbent and the Best Waiting Bound
cases: incumbent 50 with waiting bounds 70 and 64 gives the range 50 to 70
with no node waiting, both ends are the incumbent and the search is proven
the search is proven when the upper end is within the tolerance of the incumbent, even with nodes waiting
with no incumbent the lower end is None, not 0, and the search is not proven
when every waiting bound is below the incumbent, the upper end is the incumbent
